reponse: The root cause was a full disk on Kafka broker ingest-kafka-2, after infra PR #221 removed size-based retention [2]. The broker went read-only at 09:38 UTC and consumers stalled until 12:25 UTC, an outage of 2h47m with no events lost because producers buffered them [2][4]. An early agent note blamed the batch size change in #388 [1], but the team later called that a red herring [5], and Slack confirms the revert changed nothing while the disk was full [3]. Follow-up actions include alerting at 80% disk usage and restoring size-based retention [5].
